title: superlockslot
description: Prevents you from accident dropping items
body:
![Preview actionbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/254ec7eb35a4810bcf5b1d0e7843abac1f29cbe8.png)
![Preview hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75a8c37b3bdce1eb62dd08786b6f96391196c3e0.png)

Locks selected slots, so you can't drop items from them using Q (or another key).
To drop something open your inventory and drop it using Q when hover an item.

![Settings. Page Protections](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f6ab827918cacb5ef7040414621aad074ef5c17_0.webp)
![Settings. Page Feedback](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bb3f83f5c6b7ad43b30c8153e9232f9dcec63c8_0.webp)
![Settings. Page Locked slots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/935196bb8d117cc5ce880dea600a5514028e1c61_0.webp)

Dependencies:
[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions), 
[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
